title: Read an installation through a linked root and keep adopted trees' line endings
summary: readInstalledGeneration and readExpandedBundle now canonicalize the root as open does, so the ia_kb_* tools and other readers work when --root reaches the workspace through a link; a link inside the installation is still refused. ia adopt and ia init --adopt write .ia/open/.gitattributes with * -text -filter -ident -working-tree-encoding unless a regular file is already there, which keeps checkouts from converting pinned bytes unless a higher-precedence git attribute says otherwise. A bound tree that matches its pin once CRLF becomes LF is now refused with the conversion named, instead of a plain revision mismatch.
